experiment: P2w ISRJ sample-width exact-component OOD identifiability

estimator.feature: zero-padded complex autocorrelation magnitude with local smooth-background removal

baselines_and_controls.C0_constant: 12.5 microseconds, fixed from the original 5-20 us training interval
